question: Can the declared singularity-elimination surgery on the three-cycle chain be executed exactly: excising the obstruction, introducing resources helically on both sides with OPPOSITE chirality - one rotation direction outside, the other inside - so that the collar flux strictly rises, with one side writing out and discharging the obstruction while the other reaches its declared time-domain location within a declared step budget, and with the whole construction read as a spacetime statement whose declared projection is the cold/heat two-sided reading?
level: Bounded external exact calibration of a declared construction. No physical claim, no forecast, no skill claim, no observational verification, and no data used.

parent_contracts.relation: in force, retained byte for byte; where this document and that one disagree, that one governs and the disagreement is reported
its four amendments - layered slow reservoir, per-layer sealing, sampling-change control, separated uncertainty - are inherited by this run unchanged

declared_reading.surgery: The declared carrier has a singular locus - the discriminant collision of the earlier runs and the seam of the annual chain. The surgery excises a declared collar around it and replaces the singular carrier by two sides, so that the obstruction becomes an ordinary boundary object rather than a point where the construction stops. The excision is declared, not derived, and its size is part of the declaration.
declared_reading.helical_resource_introduction: On each side resources are introduced along a declared spiral: a rotation compounded with a radial advance. The two sides carry OPPOSITE chirality - a declared sign plus one outside and minus one inside (or the reverse) - and the chirality is part of the declaration, so a construction with the same chirality on both sides is a different construction and must be rejected rather than absorbed.
declared_reading.flux_raising: The collar flux after the helical introduction must be STRICTLY greater than the pre-surgery flux at the same collar, and the increase must be attributed to the helical introduction itself: the same-chirality control must fail to raise it. The flux is a declared pairing of the declared field with the declared collar normal, evaluated exactly.
declared_reading.two_sided_roles: Side O writes out and discharges the obstruction: the obstruction is declared as an explicit object with its own written record, and the discharge is a condition on that record, so an implicit or unwritten obstruction fails the condition. Side I reaches its declared time-domain location within a declared step budget: fast arrival is a bounded-step condition, not an asymptotic statement, and an arrival beyond the budget fails.
declared_reading.projection: The construction is a spacetime statement. Its declared projection to the cold/heat reading is an explicit map: the outer side projects to the side that seals, the inner side to the side that supplies or injects, and the helical pair projects to the two rotation senses of the two-sided mechanism. The projection is declared and checked as a map, and no physical cold, heat, wind or ocean quantity is asserted anywhere.
declared_reading.resources_carried: The carried remainder of the parent contract, split into fast and slow components and, under supplement one, into the three declared layers, is the resource that the spirals introduce. The helical introduction must account for it exactly: no resource may be created by the surgery, and the layer-wise sealing bound of supplement one still applies to the post-surgery carrier.

objects.collar: A declared excision neighbourhood of the singular locus, with a declared orientation and a declared normal.
objects.spiral: A declared map taking a declared radial parameter and a declared angle to a declared resource introduction; the chirality is its declared handedness.
objects.flux: The declared pairing of the introduced resource with the collar normal, computed exactly before and after the introduction.
objects.obstruction_record: The written object of side O, with its discharge condition; and the arrival condition of side I, with its declared step budget.

method.exact: All acceptance arithmetic is exact integers and fractions; sympy 1.14 is a declared non-authoritative engine where resultants, Groebner bases or Sturm counts are needed.
method.declared_controls_first: Every condition carries its calamity counterpart in the three-by-three typing of the parent contract, and a control that cannot be made to fail is reported as a failed control.

controls: Chirality: the same chirality on both sides must be rejected by rule, and the rejection must be produced by the declared chirality condition rather than by a count.
Flux: the same-chirality introduction must fail to raise the collar flux; a construction whose flux rise comes from anywhere other than the helical introduction must be reported as unattributed.
Roles: swapping the two sides' roles must fail both conditions - an unwritten obstruction must fail side O, and an over-budget arrival must fail side I.
Conservation: no resource may be created by the surgery; the layer-wise sealing bound of supplement one is checked on the post-surgery carrier and a layer-wise violation is not cancelled by a total.
Projection: the declared projection map is checked as a map; a projection that identifies the two sides, or that reads the helical pair as a single rotation sense, must be rejected.
Inherited: the sampling-change invariance control, the separated-uncertainty control and the purely-atmospheric memory-loss control of the parent contracts all still run unchanged.
acceptance: Every acceptance assertion is exact and no floating-point value appears in any acceptance test or in the retained payload. The run reports: the excised collar and its orientation; the two spirals with their declared chiralities; the collar flux before and after, with the attribution check; side O's written obstruction and its discharge verdict; side I's arrival verdict against its declared step budget; the projection map and its check; the resource accounting, including the three layers; and every control above, including any that failed to discriminate.
protected: experiments/three_cycle_chain_v1/contract.json and contract-supplement-1.json are retained byte for byte and are not edited
All pre-existing repository files remain byte identical
No Rust source, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock change, so the advance-surface base commit does not move
No data is read or used, and the authenticity reservation of the parent contract is carried un-narrowed
No native admission, no Seal, no transport and no terminology home
residual: The surgery, the collar, the spirals, the chirality signs, the flux pairing and the step budget are all declared conventions; another declaration is another run
The spacetime statement is a declared construction and its cold/heat projection is a declared map, not physics; no cold, heat, wind, ocean or plateau quantity is asserted
The chain remains future and unverified; nothing here is a forecast, a reconstruction or a skill estimate
Whether opposite chirality is necessary rather than merely declared is not decided here: the run reports what the declared pair does and what the same-chirality control does, and stops there
